values.title: Installation
values.summary: Install the CLI and SDK, connect an existing app and configure your environment variables.
values.body:
## Install the CLI

The CLI manages schemas, migrations, environments and secrets. Install it as a dev dependency so every teammate uses the same version.

```
npm install --save-dev tessera
```

## Add the SDK to an existing app

If you already have a TypeScript project, initialise Tessera inside it. The command adds `schema.ts` and a `tessera/` folder for the generated client.

Terminal

```
npx tessera init
npx tessera login
```

## Environment variables

Variable

Description

`TESSERA_PROJECT`

Your project ID, for example `prj_8f2k1`.

`TESSERA_ENV`

The environment to target. Defaults to `development`.

`TESSERA_KEY`

A server key. Never ship this to the browser.

Keep server keys private

Browser code should use the public key from `TESSERA_PUBLIC_KEY`. Server keys bypass row-level rules.

## Verify the setup

Terminal

```
npx tessera status
# ✓ project  prj_8f2k1
# ✓ env      development
# ✓ schema   in sync
```
